basis: Human/assistant visual inspection of the exact archived screenshot, not live DOM measurements
principle: Use clear benefit headlines, proof beside claims and an obvious repeated action; adapt to the client, do not copy proof, wording, colors or dated visual details.

sections.layout: Compact white header: brand left, short credibility statement middle, readable phone right.

sections.job: Offer and concrete customer result before detail
sections.layout: Centered outcome headline and explanatory supporting copy; large real demonstration video left, compact brochure/pricing CTA panel right. One high-contrast action.
Three testimonials across a dark band, middle quote in a contrasting light panel. Do not invent testimonials for a new client.
Benefit heading followed by alternating before/after proof images and concise differentiators, not an undifferentiated list of services.
Compact proof/video strip alongside a short action headline and the same CTA.

sections.job: Explain how the customer result is achieved
sections.layout: White section with a result-led heading and three alternating image/text rows: mechanism, durable outcome, complete solution. Key benefits live in headings, detail stays in short paragraphs.
Short three-item reassurance strip for response, warranty and price. Only use corresponding client facts when supported.

sections.job: Make the path to the result easy to understand
sections.layout: Outcome-led process heading, three ordered image/text steps with downward connectors, repeated CTA below.

sections.job: Summarize meaningful choice reasons and close
sections.layout: Question-led choice heading, three simple illustrated benefit columns, each with an outcome headline and concrete explanation; final primary action.

avoid_transferring: Control-specific 12-year warranty, 25-year history, customer counts or strength comparison
Control brand, images or testimonials as client proof
Tiny faint text, excessive saturated bands or old decorative styling
Forced literal section counts when buyer questions differ
